tr.title: “Nasılsın” İngilizce nasıl denir?
tr.metaDesc: Nasılsın İngilizce: how are you ve diğer sorma/cevap kalıpları. Okunuşu ve örneklerle — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: “Nasılsın?” İngilizcede en sık How are you? ile sorulur. İşte sorma ve cevap verme yolları — resmiden samimiye.

means.def: How are you? (en yaygın, nötr)
How's it going? / How are you doing? (samimi)
Cevap: I'm fine, thanks. And you?
Samimi cevap: I'm good / Not bad

tr.quizQ: “How are you?” sorusuna doğal bir cevap?

en.title: How to say and answer “How are you?”
en.metaDesc: How are you: ways to ask how someone is and how to reply, with pronunciation and examples — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: The most common way to ask how someone is doing is How are you?. Here are ways to ask and reply — from formal to casual.

means.def: How are you? (most common, neutral)
How's it going? / How are you doing? (casual)
Reply: I'm fine, thanks. And you?
Casual reply: I'm good / Not bad
